feeding_claim.verbatim: All of the Wagyu beef we sell on our farm has never been fed any grain.

resold_note: Also sells Berkshire pork from the Berkwood Farms co-op, grain-finished Australian Wagyu, Durham Ranch beef, and chicken and eggs whose source is not stated.
notes: Verifier 2026-11-15: read the homepage, FAQ, butcher shop Q and A, beef 101 and Berkshire pork pages and the shop product list. The farm raises its own Wagyu herd on local and native grasses; the FAQ says the Wagyu beef it sells has never been fed any grain, so the category is grass-finished. The homepage and shop also offer Australian Wagyu that is grain finished, Berkwood Farms co-op Berkshire pork (the farm stopped raising pigs in late 2019), Durham Ranch beef, and chicken breasts and eggs with no stated source; these are in resold_note, and only beef is listed as a species. Pickup at the farm Saturdays 9 to 11am or by appointment; the site says it ships anywhere in the US by UPS. Halves and quarters appear only on a 2013 page, so bulk shares are not recorded. Footer address is Oxford, FL 34484.
